sections.content: Questions in the pretérito perfecto use the same structure as statements: a form of haber + past participle. The subject can appear after the verb or be understood from the verb ending. In simple conversations, ¿Has...?, ¿Han...?, and ¿Qué has...? are especially useful for asking about recent experiences.

items.english: Have they arrived at the hotel?
Yes, I have travelled by train.

sections.content: In this course, plural you is ustedes: ¿Han viajado? Never use han.
